functions.name: ASK
functions.description: Ask a question about a range of cells. Batched, cached, and subject to the per-recalculation AI budget.

functions.name: EXTRACT
functions.description: Extract a named field from a cell's text. Returns #N/A when the field is absent.

functions.name: CLASSIFY
functions.description: Classify a cell into exactly one of the supplied categories.

functions.name: MATCH
functions.description: Fuzzy-match two entity names; returns TRUE when they refer to the same entity.

functions.name: FORECAST
functions.description: Forecast future periods from a history range using exponential smoothing. The numbers are computed statistically, not generated by a language model.

parameters.name: seasonLength
parameters.description: Optional periods per season (12 monthly, 4 quarterly)
